_comment: Firms NOT on a public ATS JSON board. The career-change detector (scripts/detect-career-changes.mjs) fetches each url, extracts early-career postings, and diffs against the last snapshot - exactly how a deadline tracker detects new openings. JS-heavy SPA career pages need a rendered fetch: set FIRECRAWL_API_KEY to enable it. tier must match TIER_ORDER in the tracker UI. Before adding a firm, check lib/sources/ats-registry.json: a firm whose board is reachable there is already collated with real ids, locations and deadlines, and a second pass over its marketing page adds nav links rather than roles while spending a Firecrawl credit. This registry is for firms with no reachable board, including the ones parked in the ATS registry.
